profile.name: Jackson Satermo
profile.tagline: Building useful software around real-world problems.

portrait.alt: Jackson Satermo smiling in a white shirt outdoors.

bio: I'm a software developer in Fargo who enjoys learning how people work, finding the friction in a process, and building software that makes it simpler. I like unfamiliar problems, direct feedback, and collaborating with people who understand the business from different perspectives.

At the North Dakota University System, I build and support enterprise applications used across North Dakota's public university system. My work spans Oracle SQL, PeopleCode, Application Engine, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, integrations, testing, and production support, from understanding requirements through validating and releasing changes.

Away from my keyboard, you'll usually find me playing sports, leading a large Bible study, or tinkering with 3D printing and electronics. My faith, community, and hobbies keep me grounded, curious, and usually thinking about the next thing worth building.

aboutPhotos.alt: Jackson’s Bible study group gathered in a large circle at church.
aboutPhotos.caption: Faith, friendship, and a place to belong. The Bible study community I’m grateful to lead.

experience.description: Develop, enhance, test, and support enterprise applications for the North Dakota University System. Work across Oracle SQL, PeopleCode, Application Engine, frontend technologies, integrations, and production troubleshooting while partnering with business analysts and developers to turn requirements into reliable software.
Handled escalated internet, networking, and VoIP issues in an ISP environment, using systematic troubleshooting to identify root causes and communicate practical solutions.
Provided customer-facing technical support, translating complex hardware and software problems into clear solutions for non-technical users.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
education.description: My computer science foundation spans object-oriented programming, data structures and algorithms, databases, web development, operating systems, networking, and artificial intelligence. Coursework and team projects gave me hands-on experience across Java, JavaScript, Python, SQL, and full-stack application development.

photo.alt: Jackson Satermo in a green cap and gown holding his diploma at NDSU graduation.

projects.title: AI Resume Matcher
projects.description: NDSU capstone team project for Kompletion LLC that used AI to compare job descriptions with applicant resumes and help recruiters identify strong candidates. Built with React and Chakra UI, Django, AWS PostgreSQL, and the OpenAI API.
projects.contribution: One of four capstone team members.

projects.title: Many Rooms
projects.description: I'm building Many Rooms, a full-stack web and mobile platform designed to simplify church scheduling, volunteer coordination, events, and team communication. The product includes ideas such as SMS-based Accept/Decline responses for volunteers who aren't using the app and shared workflows that help leaders resolve scheduling conflicts.

projects.title: Everyday Progress
projects.description: A personal project documenting the habits, nutrition, training, and systems behind my 100-pound weight-loss journey, with practical recipes, progress tracking, and lessons that may help others build sustainable routines.
